purpose: Truth-free geometry-consistency audit of v123 detector-vector phase shifts.
construction: For every adjacent frame pair, fit one least-squares 3D vector to the nine detector shifts using frozen view projection axes; no field, BP, q8, or truth enters.
failure_action: Close a single global 3D displacement explanation for the vector detector signal; do not train it.
boundary: A pass only establishes an approximate shared geometric cue, not local correspondence, reconstruction, or warm-start success.
